support.text:
Facts:
Petra Horvat (hereinafter the Debtor) filed for bankruptcy on October 22nd, 2024. The string of freshwater pearls with 16-inch clasped length and hand-knotted silk thread, owned by Petra Horvat, holds a monetary value of $1,625.00. The current fair market value of Petra's gold Cuban link chain necklace (24 inch length) stands at $2,475.00. The Debtor is the rightful owner of an audiologist prescribed custom-fit hearing aids with behind-the-ear receiver and noise filtering valued at $1,425.00. Legal documents confirm that Horvat owns a fireplace screen with wrought iron frame and mesh center appraised at $550.00.
